name: End Turn
description: Submit all staged orders and advance to the Resolution Phase. All factions resolve their actions, then the Maintenance Phase runs before your next turn.

name: Credits
description: The primary currency of the galaxy. Used to build facilities, maintain fleets, and fund diplomatic missions. Earned each turn from controlled trade systems.

name: Materials
description: Raw industrial goods used to construct ships and facilities. Manufacturing centers produce materials each turn.

name: Influence
description: Soft power that sways loyalty and unlocks diplomatic options. High-loyalty systems passively generate influence each turn.

name: Recruits
description: Personnel used to staff troops, crew ships, and train characters. Population-rich systems generate recruits.

name: Fleet Panel
description: Opens the Fleet Status panel. View all your fleets, their compositions, current orders, and combat readiness.

name: Characters Panel
description: Opens the Character Roster. Assign characters to fleets, bases, or missions to leverage their special abilities.

name: Intel Panel
description: Opens the Intel Reports panel. View gathered intelligence on enemy systems, fleets, and characters.

name: Active Missions
description: Opens the Active Missions panel. Track all ongoing covert operations assigned to your characters.

name: Command Overview
description: Opens the Command Overview panel. A high-level summary of all faction military and economic activity.

name: Notifications
description: Displays recent notifications and alerts. Critical events like system capture or mission outcomes appear here.

name: Tech Tree
description: Opens the Technology Research Tree. Queue research projects to unlock new ships, facilities, and faction abilities.

name: Victory Progress
description: Shows compact progress toward each victory condition. Press V to open the full Victory screen.

name: Map Filters
description: Toggle between map views: Faction Control, Loyalty Levels, Fleet Positions, and Resource Output overlays.

name: Save Game
description: Save your current game to a named slot. The game also auto-saves at the end of each Maintenance Phase.

name: Load Game
description: Load a previously saved game. Warning: loading mid-game will discard all unsaved progress.

name: Shipyard
description: Constructs new ships for your fleets each turn. Required to build capital ships. Increases fleet capacity at this system.

name: Barracks
description: Trains ground troops each maintenance phase. Increases system defense rating and recruit generation.

name: Research Lab
description: Boosts technology research output for this system. Multiple labs stack to accelerate tech completion.

name: Trade Post
description: Increases credit and materials output from this system. Works best on trade hub systems.

name: Capital Ship
description: The backbone of any battle fleet. High firepower and durability. Requires a Shipyard to produce.

name: Cruiser
description: A versatile medium warship balancing offense and defense. The workhorse of fleet engagements.

name: Corvette
description: Fast and lightly armed. Excellent for scouting, patrol, and rapid response missions.

name: Fighter Squadron
description: Small, cheap strike craft that excel in swarms. Low individual power but high volume of attacks.

name: Reconnaissance Mission
description: A covert intelligence-gathering operation. Reveals enemy system details, fleet compositions, and character locations.

name: Sabotage Mission
description: Destroys or damages enemy facilities and fleets. High-risk, high-reward covert operation.

name: Diplomatic Mission
description: Sways a neutral or enemy system toward your faction. Increases system loyalty by a significant amount on success.

name: Extraction Mission
description: Rescues a captured character or extracts a high-value asset from enemy territory.
